in_sanskrit.name: सुलभ
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: सुलभत्वम् अस्ति अत ऊर्ध्वे (sulabhatvam asti at urdhve) - The quality of being easily accessible or approachable is in that (higher place) (or, the one who makes things accessible or approachable)

in_hindi.name: सुलभ

in_tamil.long_meaning: கடையிடம் இருக்கும் (kadaiyidam irukkum) - The one who is present within reach or accessible
